evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; speech coded from burned-in phrase captions (hook at 4 fps, rest at 1 fps). Pair DJpCC0VIOiq not opened. Film clip at 11 to 14 s identified only as a film scene, no title on screen. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Why people fear starting a business (fear of losing money) and why he never lost money: he gives a 'general answer' that fear equals risk, then explains with his own examples that he lost time, energy and money only if a service business is not chosen (caption: startups, product businesses and service businesses).
audience: aspiring business owners afraid of losing money
caption_vs_video_note: Caption is a long structured text comparing startups, product and service businesses with 'conclusion: do like Matan'; the video is a podcast clip with a different structure: a story-driven answer to a poll question, only later landing on 'you must have time, energy and money' and the line 'service businesses' (partly). The caption states the service-business conclusion much more directly than the video does.

opening.s0_1: Caption 'שאלתי אנשים:' with an Instagram story card ('תגידו... מה הדבר שהכי מפחיד אתכם בלהקים עסק?') sliding in from the bottom.
opening.s1_3: Yellow quote caption 'מה מפחיד אתכם מלהקים עסק?' (0.75 to 1.75 s) over the story card; white 'זה תמיד' (2 s), red 'אותן התשובות!' (2.5 s).
opening.s3_5: 'קודם כל זה:' (3.25 s), then 'תשובה כללית של:' (3.75 s) with a reader's reply card 'פשוט מפחד, לא יודע איך להסביר'; yellow quoted word 'פחד' at 4.75 s.
opening.visual_hook: His own Instagram story question card as a prop, so the Reel starts from a real audience poll.
opening.spoken_hook: Spoken from 0 s, matches captions: 'שאלתי אנשים, מה מפחיד אתכם להקים עסק? זה תמיד אותן תשובות' (0 to 3.2 s), then 'קודם כל, זו תשובה כללית של פחד' (3.2 to 5 s); machine transcript
opening.text_hook: שאלתי אנשים: / מה מפחיד אתכם מלהקים עסק? / זה תמיד אותן התשובות!
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 17 s (spoken: 'יש סוג של עסקים שאי אפשר להפסיד בהם כסף', then 'אני אף פעם לא הפסדתי כסף' at 19 to 22 s)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: 'I asked people what scares them about starting a business' makes sense by itself
opening.works_without_sound: yes: captions and the on-screen story card carry the set-up

editing.edit_function: Information and illustration: story and reply screenshots show where the question came from, the film and stock inserts act out each line, and the three icon cards (time, energy, money) get crossed out one at a time to make the argument visual.
pacing_changes: t=0 to 10s: podcast shot with story card, a new caption every 0.5 to 1 s
t=9 to 14s: quick inserts (homeless person, film scene)
t=31 to 36s: icon cards crossed out one by one
t=44 to 53s: three scene inserts of about 3 s each
editing.ending: Last 2 s: 'בטח שאתה בכיתה א' / לעולם העסקים!' in white and green, podcast shot, ending abruptly.
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: dense insert-driven argument; the end is a half-thought so the viewer may replay for the point.

sound.delivery: Machine transcript: continuous fast speech from 0 s with gaps under 1 s, ending at about 55.6 s. Money amounts are unreliable in the transcript (it prints '300 שקל' where the captions read 300,000).
sound.sfx: inferred: whooshes on the coloured whip transitions (0, 19 s)
sound.sync: Captions change about every 0.5 to 1 s; each insert appears on the phrase naming it (e.g. 'S&P 500' with the chart at 25 s, 'עם ה-TRX שלי' with his gym story at 30 s).

text.colour_coding: White default; yellow for quoted speech ('מה מפחיד אתכם מלהקים עסק?', 'פחד', 'להפסיד כסף'); red for emphasis ('אותן התשובות!', 'יום אחד נמות!', 'לא תצליח!', 'הפסדתי כסף', 'זה לא עבד!'); green for 'שאתה הולך להקים עסק!' and 'ויש לך זמן!'.
text.placement: Centre of the frame at about 55%, one or two lines.
text.style: Bold Hebrew sans-serif with black outline; two-line captions; reply cards drawn as white message boxes.
text.density_and_read_time: 2 to 5 words per caption, changing every 0.5 to 1 s; easy.
text.language: Direct, argumentative, with quoted audience replies ('פשוט מפחד, לא יודע איך להסביר') and second person; quotes use ”…“.
text.caption_structure: Very long: first line is a claim 'never lost money', then three paragraphs comparing startups, product and service businesses with ❌ ✅ emojis and ends 'מסקנה, תעשו כמו מתן ✊'. No CTA.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; 'S&P 500-ב' shows the Hebrew prefix after the English; '₪300,000' renders with the sign left of the digits; follower message cards mix Hebrew and blurred names.

story.setup: He asked his followers what scares them about starting a business: the answers are always the same.
story.progression: General fear answer, then the fear of losing money; examples: contract signing, the market crash, his TRX gym; three resources (time, energy, money) crossed out in turn; a follower asks for help after losing 200,000 as a partner; a juice-stand example ending with 300,000 lost; and a restaurant kitchen example.
story.payoff: Partly: he says in service businesses you lose time and energy but not money (spoken at 17 to 23 s and 31 to 37 s, machine transcript); the full conclusion in the caption is not spoken; the last spoken line (about 54 to 55.6 s) is unclear in the transcript.
story.resolution: Closes mid-argument with a line about the first grade of business.
friction_points: t=44 to 53s: two long insert scenes with the claim carried only by captions (interpretation)
caption promises a clear 'why I never lost money' conclusion, but the video ends mid-thought (interpretation)

engagement.comment_notes: Only 7 comments in the sample (not representative): objections about fear of marketing costs and of losing all resources, a question about the shirt, one comment on personal development.

conversion.benefit: Not losing money when starting a business (implied).
conversion.proof: His own stories and a follower reply.
conversion.objection_handling: The 'no time' / 'no energy' / 'no money' objections are shown as icons crossed out.

pair_match.notes: Comparison Reel for DJpCC0VIOiq (May 2025, about 60 s, business strategy talk, per dossier note); pair not opened. Duration 55.6 s is within 30 percent of about 60 s. Topic and format match by dossier description only.

rights_and_privacy: Third-party film clips (young man and a woman scene), stock images and an unrelated trading-floor video are used; follower names are blurred; a worker at a juice stand and kitchen staff appear unblurred; his own TRX story shows another person's face partially.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: opens from a real follower poll and shows replies as social proof; the time-energy-money icons make a clear visual argument.
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the caption's strong conclusion is not in the video, the Reel ends mid-thought, and it has no CTA or hook number (about 48K views against a top Reel's 200K+).
